about: meta QA 11-25 rows 82 and 119: script paths that point where nothing is, still carried, each with why its fix is not this repo's; shrink only (node .githooks/script-paths.mjs --prune).

findings.finding: scripts/blender/: stray in scripts/ (src/scripts/ is the lean home: move it under src/, or baseline why it stays)
findings.why: Under src/blender/ the manifest joins the hero content hash (src/ less scripts/ and static/), and Sky Reach's uncurated hero then needs a fresh capture before main ci's build passes; the move rides with that capture (meta QA 11-25 row 129). The SDK's build.sh already reads either place (sharddev 220ea7e7).
